purpose: Prefix-only price-risk audit; no coefficient selection from audit outcomes
universe: Current active Shanghai securities, sort SHA256(symbol), first 120; disclose survivorship bias
signal_dates: Cached benchmark positions [-242:-2:10], fixed before outcome calculation; no 2026-10-21 feedback day
financial_reason: No point-in-time historical financial snapshots; never backfill today's cached facts into old dates
baseline: Existing anti-chase hard vetoes and descending raw technical score, ATR tie break
candidate: Same hard vetoes; risk-adjust technical score using only prior 60 daily returns and 20-day liquidity proxy
risk_formula: min(30, 2*ATR14_pct + 3*downside_deviation60_pct*(1.5 if index close<MA60 and return20<0 else 1) + 0.25*max_drawdown60_pct + 10*(1-min(1,median20(raw_close*volume_lots*100)/20000000)))
score_formula: 0.60*max(0,technical_raw-risk_penalty); financial unavailable in this historical price-only audit
outcome: D1 raw open to D2 raw close, fixed 0.30 percentage-point roundtrip cost stress; top1 and equal-weight top5
benchmarks: same-date Shanghai index D1 open to D2 close
deployment_rule: Do not change coefficients after this audit. If both mean versus same-date benchmark and lower-tail outcomes worsen, keep candidate offline. Other tradeoffs must be disclosed, never claim validated accuracy.
limitations: current qfq history cannot restore every historical adjustment vintage
